ef_springs_attendant: One coin, or a bucket of charcoal, or an hour walking the pans. Your choice.
Start in the far pools. They are the cool ones, and the city will hear about it if you do not.
ef_springs_smith: Forty years at a forge mouth and my hands still open in the morning. That is these pools.
Every other forge town I have worked, the smiths are old at forty. Not here.
ef_springs_traveller: I have soaked in Salthollow, in the salt baths at Tideglass, and once in a barrel in Stonewake.
This is the only water that was hot before anybody touched it.
It changes how you sit in it. I cannot explain that better than I just did.
